Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. Unless you have 2 suspended Digimon for the DNA digivolution, you can't digivolve because of this card's effect.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent activates this card's [On Play] effect. Can I DNA digivolve an unsuspended Digimon and a suspended Digimon in the next turn?

a: effects read "when one of your Digimon digivolves," so unless the Digimon for the digivolution is in a state where it can digivolve, the effect can't activate.
q: My opponent activates this card's [On Play] effect. Can I use a
effect to suspend an unsuspended Digimon and then digivolve that Digimon in the next turn?

a: No, you can't. [BT4-011 Agunimon]'s effect reads "You may digivolve this card from your hand onto one of your red Tamers as if the Tamer is a level 3 red Digimon," so it is considered to be an unsuspended Digimon and can't digivolve.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent activates this card's [On Play] effect. Can I digivolve an unsuspended Tamer into a [BT4-011 Agunimon] in the next turn?

Effect: [On Play] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ all of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with a play cost of 5 or less. If no Digimon is deleted by this effect, none of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon can digivolve until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Opponent's Turn] While you have a Tamer in play, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and ＜Reboot＞.
